question: Related Questions Q. Someone dreamnt of saidina Ali karamallahuawajha.My question is,is it possible if shaitan laknatullah pretend to be one of the sahabah. 1561 views Q. In the present day there is a beloved person of Allah about whom many Muslims from different countries, cities and sects had seen in their dreams with Muhammad (SAW) before they actually met him. Possible? 1497 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, I am sorry this is very complicated. I do not know whether this is a dream or something else, but something very weird happened to me this morning. After Salat Al Fajr, I went to bed and started thinking about death and motherhood (I am not married)- I then just said the sleeping du'a and kalimah and closed my eyes. I don't know whether I was sleeping or not, but I had a "dream" where I remember having a flashback of being in the hospital with a baby, then there was a photocopier and all of the sudden I had to make 4 copies on A4, the copies came out on A3 and the copier was making a noise as if though it was damaged. When I tried to stop the copier, it was like I had gone into some kind of wajd, I couldn't touch the photocopier and my body felt a little paralysed- it was like I was underwater, but I was not, I was in this dreamy life; soon I started descending, almost floating and this was the weird thing- I was going down, floating down. Then I remember thinking that it maybe revelation, but then thought it must be death, so I whispered half the kalimah and all of the sudden my eyes opened- I was in my bed in the position I was floating down in; I then tried moving and Al hamdu lillah I moved and found that I was on my right side perfectly fine. I looked at the time and found that it was only 20 minutes after I had come to sleep. I was scared because I did not know whether I was asleep or not, or whether I was awake because I did not feel sleepy and Allahu 'alam. I have had the experience of sleep paralysis due to jinns, but this was different. I am very sorry for the detail. Jazak Allahu khair. 3626 views Q. Dream Interpretation 1929 views Q. My sister-in-law experience a dream about wife that they both are standing at the top of very hight clif and my wife is advising her sister not to move an inch otherwise they would fall. But suddently my wife herself fall from that cliff. My sister-in-law expereince this dream twice and on both occasions my wife falls from the height. 1798 views Q. Dream 1646 views Q. DREAMS: Please interpret this dream for me. I am with my mum and mother's sister. I see 6 moons in front of me in the horizon. Each of these moons are arranged in such an order that they partially overlap one another, and these moons are full, with very bright outlines.One of the moons has the word Allah written on it in Arabic, while another moon has the word Eid Mubarak written on it in arabic. I dont know what was written on the other moons. When i see these moons, they appear big in appearance and very beautiful to look at.I ask my mothers sister to look at the moons, but she is not able to view it,,, and i think she may have been able to see it later. I am very happy in my dream when i see these moons. 1504 views Q. I saw a dream on 28/05/08 at 4.30 am i saw that three tigers have lept in my room they are harmless but then too i am scared of them iam trying to ward them off by flickering a torch in their eyes please interpret it. 1683 views Q. A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. 1457 views Q. I hope you are well and happy. My mother had done istikhara for many days for my sister regarding marriage. 1. These are the dreams my mother had: 1.She is going inside a shop and selecting Comforter(huge thick blanket). She selecting one comforter, she says: ''This comforter is 100% allright but from this I have to select 1,2,3." A little background of the potential husband: He has two brothers, one elder to him and one younger to him. 2.She sees fire(about the height of man) burning. In a corner she sees an unknown girl standing. My mother's second brother that is my Uncle Nazeer puts off the fire! Then she is breastfeeding an infant and the infant refuses to drink. 3.She is breastfeeding an infant and only a drop goes inside the infant's mouth and it spits out and my mother's whole face gets covered with milk. 4. She is standing on some platform little above the ground, a lady brings fresh milk in a bottle. My mother says: "I cant get down, please go and keep it in refrigerator." 5. She saw some crows. She recognises one crow as a male. She then wonders" How was I able to differentiate between a male and femal crow? Before I was not able to recognise a male crow or a female crow". These are the dreams my mother had. Dear Mufti, my mother is confused as to what to do. Please tell me the taabeer of dreams. 1677 views Q.
